# Stambha Consultants

> Structural engineering consultancy based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founded by Neeraj Agarwal, Stambha Consultants delivers structural design, analysis, and audit services to architects, real estate developers, and construction firms across Jaipur and Rajasthan, working to Indian Standards IS 456, IS 800, IS 1893, and IS 2950.

Stambha Consultants specializes in:
- RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) Structural Design for residential, commercial, and industrial projects
- Steel Structure Design
- Foundation Design & Analysis, including soil-structure interaction
- Structural Drawings & Detailing
- Earthquake-Resistant (seismic) Design
- Structural Audits & Retrofitting for existing buildings

Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, serving clients across Rajasthan. Contact: stambhaconsultants@gmail.com / +91 9875803748.
